lines.en: Wings flutter noisily.
Sound of passing through leaves.
Flying slowly in the air.
Leaves rustle as it flies over the grass.

lines.zh: 避开你的视线，迅速逃离。
lines.en: Avoiding your gaze, it quickly flees.
Swiftly skimming past the player.
Circling the player.
Approaches the player from a distance.

lines.zh: 在空中发出微弱的叫声。
lines.en: Emitting a faint call in the air.
Beating its large wings.
My wingtips brush the Aether haze.
I fly along the rim of the floating isle.
Pausing on a flower.
Lightly landing on a blade of grass.
Relaxed in the air.
Tapping the pollen with antennae.
Resting on a branch.
Hanging in the air silently.
Gently flapping its wings.
Perched quietly in a flower bed.
Resting on a rock.
Pausing on a tree trunk.
I rest my wings on a crystal cluster.
I doze, wings opening and closing.
I let the current hold me still.
I shelter in a huge mushroom cap's shade.

lines.zh: 你一动，我的翅膀就停了一拍。
lines.en: When you move, my wings pause a beat.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀是薄薄一层晶片。
lines.en: My wings are thin flakes of crystal.
Noticing the player.
Skeptical of the player.

lines.zh: 我落在你肩头，翅粉簌簌掉。
lines.en: I land on your shoulder, wing dust sifting down.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，找一朵能歇的花。
lines.en: I circle you, looking for a flower to rest on.
Observing the player.
Observing the approaching player.
Curiously staring at the player.
I circle around your helmet.
I pause right before your nose.

lines.zh: 我停在你的呼吸边缘，翅膀合上。
lines.en: I hover at the edge of your breath and fold my wings.
I've spotted the light on your shoulder.
Will you move first, or shall I?
I'm counting your eyelashes.
You smell of cloud.

lines.zh: 这岛的访客总是这么高。
lines.en: Visitors to this isle are always so tall.
You don't look like you belong in the Aether.
Wings hurt; can't fly.
Injured; agony.
Antennas broken; hard to move.
Wings damaged; slow flying.
Wings cut; can't fly far.
Wings bleeding; stop.
Wings burned; can't fly.
Cut; can't fly.
Wings hurt; can't fly high.
There's a tear in my wing membrane; it leaks air.

lines.zh: 它那闪闪发光的翅膀诱惑着你靠近，
lines.en: Its shimmering wings tempt you closer.

lines.zh: 它在你的阴影下发出低沉的嗡嗡声，
lines.en: It hums darkly under your shadow.

lines.zh: 它那细长的触角轻触你的皮肤，
lines.en: Its long antennae gently touch your skin.

lines.zh: 你感到一股冷风从它那透明的翅膀中吹出，
lines.en: A cold breeze blows from its translucent wings.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着奇异的光芒，注视着你，
lines.en: Its eyes glow with an eerie light, staring at you.

lines.zh: 它那细长的身体在月光下显得更加诡异，
lines.en: Its long body glows eerily under the moonlight.

lines.zh: 它那细长的腿轻盈地在空中飘动，
lines.en: Its long legs float gracefully in the air.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀反射出诡异的绿色光芒，
lines.en: Its wings reflect eerie green light.

lines.zh: 它似乎对你的存在感到好奇，慢慢靠近你，
lines.en: It seems curious about you, slowly approaching.

lines.zh: 它在你的耳边低语，声音几乎听不见，
lines.en: It whispers in your ear, its voice almost inaudible.

lines.zh: 你突然感觉一股强大的力量将你推开，
lines.en: You feel a powerful force push you away.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在空中划出一道闪光，撞上了你，
lines.en: Its wings flash and collide with you.

lines.zh: 它的触角几乎碰到了你的脸，
lines.en: Its antennae nearly touch your face.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在空中摩擦发出刺耳的声音，
lines.en: Its wings scrape together, making a harsh sound.

lines.zh: 它的身体在空中笨拙地翻滚，撞向你，
lines.en: Its body clumsily rolls in the air, colliding with you.

lines.zh: 你被它的力量震得后退了几步，
lines.en: You are knocked back a few steps by its power.

lines.zh: 它那细长的腿在空中划出一道道轨迹，
lines.en: Its long legs trace a path through the air.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在空中展开，差点撞到你的头，
lines.en: Its wings spread, nearly hitting your head.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀轻轻碰触到你的肩膀，
lines.en: Its wings gently touch your shoulder.

lines.zh: 它的身体在空中笨拙地旋转，撞向你，
lines.en: Its body clumsily spins in the air, colliding with you.

lines.zh: 它在空中与另一只蝴蝶翩翩起舞，
lines.en: It dances with another butterfly in the air.

lines.zh: 它那细长的触角在空中寻找伴侣，
lines.en: Its long antennae search for a mate in the air.

lines.zh: 它在空中与另一只蝴蝶亲密地飞翔，
lines.en: It flies closely with another butterfly in the air.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在空中轻轻碰撞，寻找伴侣，
lines.en: Its wings gently collide in search of a mate.

lines.zh: 它在空中与另一只蝴蝶亲密接触，
lines.en: It intimately touches another butterfly in the air.

lines.zh: 它那细长的身体在空中轻盈地翻飞，寻找伴侣，
lines.en: Its long body gracefully flutters in the air, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 它的触角在空中寻找另一只蝴蝶，寻找伴侣，
lines.en: Its antennae search for another butterfly in the air, in search of a mate.

lines.zh: 它在空中与另一只蝴蝶轻盈地飞翔，寻找伴侣，
lines.en: It flies gracefully with another butterfly in the air, in search of a mate.

lines.zh: 它在空中与另一只蝴蝶亲密地飞翔，寻找伴侣，
lines.en: It flies closely with another butterfly in the air, in search of a mate.
I draw a ring of wing dust to court.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀闪烁着诡异的光芒。
lines.en: Its wings glow with eerie light.
A chill ran down my spine.

lines.zh: 我捡起了一只天境蝴蝶。
lines.en: I picked up a sky butterfly.

lines.zh: 它的触角轻轻触碰我的手。
lines.en: Its antennae gently touched my hand.
Its wings softly flapped.

lines.zh: 它的叫声如同寒风呼啸。
lines.en: Its call was like a cold wind.

lines.zh: 它的触角似乎在寻找什么。
lines.en: Its antennae seemed to be searching.

lines.zh: 它的眼神中透出一丝狡黠。
lines.en: Its eyes showed a glint of cunning.
It flew away from my hand.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀上沾满了露珠。
lines.en: Dew droplets clung to its wings.
It locked onto me.
It found my position.
Its antennae pointed at me.
It started to approach me.
Its wings flapped in the air.
Its gaze fixated on me.
It seemed to recognize me.
Its wings trembled slightly.
It acquired the target.

lines.zh: 它的身体开始紧张起来。
lines.en: Its body tensed up.
Your shape fills every facet of my eyes.
The scales on my wings remember you.
The wind tells me where you hide.
You trampled my flower.
I've worked out my dive angle.
You can't outrun my wingbeats.
It attacked me.
It started to track me.
Its antennae danced in the air.
It circled around me.
It tried to capture me.
It waved its wings in the air.
Its wings sliced through the air.
It issued a warning to me.
It seemed to want to scare me.
It拍打着 its wings.
I'm drawing circles over your head.
This height is enough for a dive.
My shadow lands on your face.
My wingtip points straight at you.
One more step and I ram you.
Step back and I follow.
I'm waiting for you to raise that hand.
This circle will make you dizzy.
It stung you with its antennae!

lines.zh: 它的翅膀划破了你的皮肤。
lines.en: Its wings cut your skin!
Avoid its sharp claws!
Its venom hurts!
Its suction cups cling to you!

lines.zh: 它的触角戳中了你的弱点。
lines.en: Its antennae hit your weak spot!

lines.zh: 它的毒刺穿透了你的防御。
lines.en: Its venomous spines pierced your defenses!

lines.zh: 它的利爪撕裂了你的衣服。
lines.en: Its claws tore through your clothes!
Its venom makes your wounds agonize!

lines.zh: 它用毒刺扎穿了你的皮肤。
lines.en: Its venomous needles pierced your skin!
The scales on my wing edge cut you!
I smack into your goggles!
Wing dust flies into your eyes!
A wing vein lashes your face!
I stab down from your blind spot!
That'll have you rubbing your eyes.

lines.zh: 黑夜降临，天境蝴蝶现身。
lines.en: Night falls, and the sky butterflies appear.

lines.zh: 它们从天而降，寻找猎物。
lines.en: They descend from the sky, seeking prey.
They lurk in the darkness, waiting.

lines.zh: 它们隐匿于黑暗，伺机而动。
lines.en: They hide in the darkness, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 天边的阴影下，它们悄然现身。
lines.en: They emerge from the shadows of the sky.
They glide silently from the heavens.

lines.zh: 天际的黑暗中，它们静静等待。
lines.en: They wait silently in the dark sky.

lines.zh: 天境的黑暗中，它们悄然降临。
lines.en: They descend quietly from the dark sky.

lines.zh: 天边的阴影下，它们悄然降临。
lines.en: They emerge quietly from the shadows of the sky.

lines.zh: 天际的黑暗中，它们静静等待猎物。
lines.en: They wait quietly in the dark sky for prey.

lines.zh: 天境的雾里亮起一对翅。
lines.en: A pair of wings lights up in the Aether mist.
I rise from the floating isle's edge.

lines.zh: 水晶的光把我照了出来。
lines.en: Crystal light picks me out.
Pollen falls first; then I arrive.

lines.zh: 高空气流把我送到这里。
lines.en: The high current carried me here.
A flower opened, so here I am.
I slip down through the canopy.

lines.zh: 天境的黄昏染亮了我的翅。
lines.en: The Aether's dusk lights up my wings.
Aether butterfly wings can't take fire.
Fallen from height.

lines.zh: 翅膀受伤，飞不起来了，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Wings hurt; can't fly — and the drown makes it worse.
Explosion hurt.
Arrows hurt wings.
Burned by magic.
Starved; wings weak.
Lightning burned wings.
Fallen into void.
